title: EffComp: Efficient Prompt Compression via Hybrid Reinforcement & Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.02766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prompt compression is aimed at reducing input prompt lengths to enable cheaper, faster, and potentially higher-quality LLM predictions. However, existing prompt compression methods are often limited by modest compression gains, a risk of hallucination, and/or high compression latency. We propose EffComp, an Efficient prompt Compression framework for RAG-based question answering (QA). EffComp employs BERT-style document reranker and sentence selector models to allow fast extractive prompt compression at the sentence level. Its extractive nature prevents hallucinations in the compressed prompts. Additionally, the training process using a hybrid reinforcement and supervised learning approach is designed to optimize the compression ratio while preserving LLM accuracy. translated_title: EffComp：通过混合强化学习与监督学习实现高效提示压缩
translated_abstract: 提示压缩旨在缩短输入提示的长度，从而实现更廉价、更快速且可能更高质量的大语言模型（LLM）预测。然而，现有的提示压缩方法往往受限于压缩增益有限、存在幻觉风险和/或压缩延迟高等问题。我们提出了EffComp，一个面向基于RAG的问答（QA）任务的高效提示压缩框架。EffComp采用BERT风格的文档重排序模型和句子选择模型，实现句子级别的快速抽取式提示压缩。其抽取式的特性可以防止压缩后的提示中出现幻觉。此外，该框架采用强化学习与监督学习相结合的混合训练方法，旨在优化压缩比的同时保持LLM的准确性。在多个问答数据集上的实验表明，EffComp优于当前最先进的提示压缩方法，在压缩比与（准确率）之间实现了最佳权衡。
tldr: 提出了EffComp框架，通过结合BERT风格的重排序与句子选择模型以及混合强化学习和监督学习的训练方式，为基于RAG的问答任务实现无幻觉、低延迟且在压缩比与准确率之间达到最佳平衡的句子级抽取式提示压缩。
en_tdlr: EffComp is an efficient extractive prompt compression framework for RAG-based QA that leverages BERT-style reranking and sentence selection models trained with a hybrid reinforcement and supervised learning approach, achieving the best compression-accuracy trade-off without hallucination or high latency.
